name: 矩形薄壁堰流量计算器

map.由流量系数、堰宽与堰上水头，按 Q=(2/3)Cd·b·√(2g)·H^1.5: Compute weir discharge Q = (2/3)*Cd*b*sqrt(2g)*H^1.5 from discharge coefficient, weir width and head over the crest.
map.适用于无侧收缩、自由出流的矩形薄壁堰。: For rectangular sharp-crested weirs with no side contraction and free outflow.
map.明渠流量用薄壁堰计量。: Measure open-channel flow by sharp-crested weir.
map.按堰宽与水头算泄流。: Compute discharge by weir width and head.
map.H 0.3→0.45，Q 增约 1.84 倍（H^1.5），量水堰对水头敏感需精: H 0.3→0.45 raises Q about 1.84× (H^1.5); a measuring weir is head-sensitive and needs precise measurement.
map.上游流速大时需加行近速度水头，否则 Q 偏低。: When upstream velocity is large, add approach velocity head, otherwise Q is too low.
map.下游水位淹过堰顶时泄量受顶托下降，需测下游水头修正。: When downstream level overtops the crest, discharge drops due to backwater; measure downstream head for correction.
